name: Bangla-SGP: Bangla Text-to-Gloss Translation Dataset for Bangla Sign Language
description: Bangla-SGP is a parallel sentence-gloss dataset designed for Bangla Sign Language (BdSL) text-to-gloss translation. Published at AACL-IJCNLP 2026, it contains 4,000 sentence-gloss pairs, combining 1,000 expert human-annotated sentences by a certified professional signer with 3,000 synthetically augmented pairs developed through morphological and syntactic transformation rules.
